candidates.change_summary: Change the condition from msg.value > MinDeposit to msg.value >= MinDeposit, allowing deposits exactly equal to 1 ether to be accepted.
Delete the require statement that checks for overflow, which allows the deposit even when overflow would occur, but changes balances differently when an overflow happens.

Remove the overflow check by replacing the require with an assignment that unconditionally updates the balance (bypasses the overflow guard), changing balances when an overflow would have been caught.
Replace the statement balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value with balances[msg.sender] = msg.value, so instead of adding to the balance, it overwrites it.
Insert a line doubling msg.value before it is added to balances, so the deposited amount is double what was actually sent.
Change the deposit to use a hardcoded address instead of msg.sender, so balances are updated for a fixed address rather than the caller.
Replace `msg.value > MinDeposit` with `msg.value >= MinDeposit` in the Deposit function.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value` with `balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender] + msg.value + 1` in the Deposit function.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value` with `balances[msg.sender] += msg.value - 1` in the Deposit function.
Delete the require statement checking overflow in the Deposit function.
Delete the entire if condition block, leaving the Deposit function body empty.
Replace `if(msg.value > MinDeposit)` with `if(msg.value > 0)` in the Deposit function.
Remove the require check that ensures no overflow in balances update, allowing silent overflow
Change the condition to always true, allowing CashOut even with insufficient balance
Change the subtraction to addition, increasing the balance instead of decreasing
